1. Log into your account on [https://duke.3dprinteros.com/](https://duke.3dprinteros.com/)

2. You can use the Co-Lab printers or add the BME class-specific printers in CIEMAS B209.

    - Under the `Printers` tab, choose `Add Workgroup Printers`

    - `B209` access code: `TheDungeon209`
